stories.title: Tag tasks and filter by tag

acceptance.when: the user adds the tags "work" and "urgent" to it
acceptance.then: the task shows both tags, and reading the task back returns both tags

acceptance.given: tasks tagged "work" and tasks without that tag
acceptance.when: the user filters the task list by "work"
acceptance.then: only the tasks tagged "work" are listed
the task no longer shows it and no longer appears when filtering by "work"

acceptance.when: the user tries to add an empty tag or a tag longer than 30 characters
acceptance.then: the tag is rejected with a validation message and the task's tags are unchanged

acceptance.when: the user adds "Work" or filters by "WORK"
acceptance.then: "Work" and "work" are treated as the same tag: the task still has one such tag, and it is listed by the filter

acceptance.when: the user adds another, different tag
acceptance.then: the tag is rejected with a validation message and the task's tags are unchanged

requirements.text: Users MUST be able to add one or more tags to an existing task in one action.
Every read of a task (single task and task list) MUST return the task's tags, in a stable order (alphabetical). Tags are stored, matched, filtered and shown in lower case.

Tags MUST be case-insensitive: two tags that differ only in letter case are the same tag, a task never holds both, and adding a tag the task already has never creates a second one. Adding a tag the task already has is a silent no-op (success, task unchanged, counts once toward the 10).
Users MUST be able to filter the task list by one tag; only tasks that have that tag (ignoring case) are listed; the filter combines with all existing list filters and sort.

Users MUST be able to remove a tag from a task; afterwards the task no longer shows it and the tag filter no longer lists it. Removing a tag the task doesn't have is a silent no-op (success, task unchanged); an unknown task id is still not found.
The system MUST reject an empty tag (after trimming spaces) or a tag longer than 30 characters with a validation message naming the tags field, leaving the task's tags unchanged.
The system MUST reject an addition that would give a task more than 10 tags with a validation message, leaving the task's tags unchanged.
Tags MUST be kept with the task (they survive an app restart) and removed with it when the task is deleted.

rules.text: A tag is 1 to 30 characters long after spaces around it are removed.
Tags are case-insensitive: "Work" and "work" are the same tag.
A task has at most 10 tags.
A task's tags belong to it alone and are deleted with it; editing, completing, archiving or restoring a task never changes its tags.
